verdict.rationale: LegalZoom publishes a flat registered-agent price of $249/year and states up front that the service auto-renews each year at the purchase rate. The renewal price is therefore disclosed at purchase, but the docs also note the renewal rate is subject to change. Missing for 10: a guaranteed or locked renewal price (the docs say it is subject to change), and independent or hands-on corroboration of actual renewal charges.

support.subject: As a founder, registered-agent service has a published flat annual price, with the renewal price stated up front

citations.quote: The service auto-renews at the purchase rate each year until you cancel.
